fusions.name: Barbed Tooth
fusions.desc: Spits a barbed tooth at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 7 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Darting Shoal
fusions.desc: Sends 3 small biters out in a spread, each dealing 3 damage. 20% of the damage they deal comes back to you as healing over the following 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Loosed Brood
fusions.desc: Calls up a swarm of pups that fights for 15 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Never Still
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover restores 6 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
